newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS Holding sees consolidated 1996 loss.
newsitem.headline: CS Holding sees consolidated 1996 loss.

text.p: CS Holding said it expected its consolidated profit before deduction of minority interests to total around 1.8 billion Swiss francs ($1.3 billion) in 1996, including ordinary credit provisions of 1.2 billion.

But after extraordinary reserves, provisions and depreciation of a total 3.9 billion francs, CS Holding will report a consolidated loss before deduction of minority interests of around 2.1 billion for 1996, CS Holding said.
However, in view of good operating results, the board will propose to the general meeting that the dividend for 1996 be maintained at the 1995 level.
